response.text: I'll start by verifying the key claims in the notes, beginning with the unbalanced journals, the account reference check, duplicate invoices, AP-to-GL tie-out, and closed-period postings.

arguments.sql: SELECT l."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr FROM "GLJRNL" l GROUP BY l."JRNL_NO" HAVING ABS(SUM(l."DR_AMT") - SUM(l."CR_AMT")) > 0.005
SELECT l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD" FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" c WHERE TRIM(UPPER(c."ACCT_CD")) = TRIM(UPPER(l."ACCT_CD")))

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_AMT", i."INV_DT" FROM "APINVH" i WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" j WHERE j."INV_ID" <> i."INV_ID" AND LTRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(j."VEND_CD"),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g'),'0') = LTRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(i."VEND_CD"),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g'),'0') AND j."INV_AMT" = i."INV_AMT" AND j."INV_DT" = i."INV_DT")

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", (SELECT SUM(l."DR_AMT") - SUM(l."CR_AMT") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO" = i."JRNL_NO") AS jrnl_net FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."JRNL_NO" IS NULL OR ABS(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l."CR_AMT") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO" = i."JRNL_NO" AND l."ACCT_CD" IN (SELECT "ACCT_CD" FROM "GLCOA" WHERE "ACCT_TYP"='LIABILITY')),0) - i."INV_AMT") > 0.005

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT", p."START_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID" = h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."CLOSE_DT" IS NOT NULL AND (h."POST_DT" < p."START_DT" OR h."POST_DT" > p."END_DT")
